summaryZh: 用细密闭合的墨线与层层矿物色重绘主体，叶脉、羽毛和花瓣清楚，色面厚实而安静，保留照片的完整构图。
summaryEn: Repaint the subject with precise enclosed ink contours and layered mineral colors, preserving feather, vein and petal structure throughout the original composition.
sampleTitleEn: White Magnolia in a Glass Vase
samplePrompt: A natural editorial still-life photograph, portrait orientation 4:5, exactly 1024 x 1280 pixels. One transparent cylindrical glass vase centered slightly right on a pale limestone tabletop, holding three slender branching stems of white magnolia blossoms and fresh green leaves. A single closed magnolia bud lies on the table at the lower left. Soft side daylight from the left, quiet warm gray plaster wall, realistic translucent petals and glass, gentle shadows, entire vase and all branches visible with breathing room. This is an ordinary source photograph before any artistic conversion: no illustration, decorative border, lettering, logos, signature, or watermark.
sampleAnalysis: Planned source: one transparent cylindrical vase stands slightly right of center, holding three branching magnolia stems with white blossoms and green leaves. One closed bud rests at lower left on a pale stone tabletop; illumination comes from the left. Verify actual blossom counts, stem attachments, vase shape and occlusions from the generated source.
mediumAnchor: Repaint the supplied photograph as meticulous gongbi painting with fine enclosed ink contours, layered mineral pigments and carefully articulated natural forms.

fragments.text: Trace important silhouettes with fine controlled ink lines; vary pressure at joints while keeping petal, feather and leaf boundaries coherent.
Translate source colors into restrained mineral pigments; build opaque local colors through thin successive layers rather than photographic gradients.
Describe feather groups, leaf veins and overlapping petals selectively; keep their observed directions and attachment points anatomically plausible.
Let fine silk or prepared-paper grain appear beneath flat pigment areas; avoid rough impasto, heavy stains and digital airbrush gloss.
Preserve the source framing and spatial relationships; simplify distant background detail without moving subjects or adding decorative motifs.
Deliver one uninterrupted painting with quietly layered colors and legible contours, without calligraphy, seals, borders or a photographic comparison panel.

preserve: Original subject counts, poses, defining silhouettes and facing directions
Relative positions, overlap order and visible anatomical attachments
Full composition and existing negative space
Distinctive identifying colors while translating their material appearance
negative: Loose broken travel-sketch contours
Photographic feather texture pasted over painted areas
Extra birds, flowers or decorative species
Invented inscriptions, seals, emblems or signatures
Impasto, collage borders, comparison panels and watermarks
acceptanceZh: 主体数量、姿态和遮挡关系与原图一致
轮廓细而完整，花瓣叶脉或羽毛结构可辨
矿物色色面分层清楚，既非照片滤镜也非厚涂
整幅连续绘画，无额外文字、印章或对照拼版
acceptanceEn: Subject counts, poses and occlusions match the source
Fine coherent contours retain readable organic structures
Layered pigment fields clearly replace photographic rendering without impasto
One continuous painting contains no added lettering, seals or comparison panels
geometryNoteZh: 适合主体边界清楚的花鸟、人物与器物；不把叶脉、衣纹或羽毛数量写死为通用规则，按实际原图取舍。
geometryNoteEn: Use for clearly bounded natural subjects, portraits and objects; derive vein, garment and feather structures from the actual source rather than fixed example counts.

summaryZh: 沿原照山脊和水路组织远近层次，以石青石绿般的矿彩覆盖山面，保留岩石结构与开阔水域，形成完整青绿山水。
summaryEn: Keep the source ridgelines and waterways while rebuilding depth through layered blue-green mineral mountains, articulated rock faces and open water.
sampleTitleEn: Twin Peaks above a River Bend
samplePrompt: Create a natural landscape photograph, vertical 4:5, exactly 1024x1280 pixels. A quiet river enters at the bottom center and bends toward the middle left between two steep limestone peaks. The nearer peak occupies the right half and has a stepped rocky ridge; a narrower distant peak rises at upper left. A low wooded bank follows the river at lower left, with five clearly separated pine trees along the near bank. Pale morning mist sits only between the distant slopes. Soft daylight, realistic limestone strata, green vegetation and muted gray-blue water, no fantasy geology. Entire peaks and the full foreground river bend stay inside the frame with a modest strip of pale sky. No people, boats, buildings, painting, text, watermark or logo.
sampleAnalysis: Planned source: two principal limestone peaks frame one river, with the larger stepped peak on the right and narrower distant peak on the upper left; the river curves from bottom center toward middle left. Five pines line the near left bank. Verify ridge shapes and tree count from the generated source.
mediumAnchor: Transform the supplied landscape into blue-green mineral painting, using layered azurite-like blues and malachite-like greens over structurally drawn mountain forms.

fragments.text: Follow the original major ridgelines, valley openings and river course; organize depth through overlapping terrain rather than newly invented mountains.
Define rock planes with tapered ink contours and short structural texture strokes aligned to the observed slopes and strata.
Layer muted blue and green mineral colors across mountain faces; retain warm stone underpainting in selected edges and exposed planes.
Make pigment granular and matte with visible underdrawing; preserve small unpainted separations between neighboring mountain planes.
Express distance with lighter, thinner pigment and softened contours; keep foreground slopes materially denser without cinematic light beams.
Keep water and sky spacious with restrained pale washes; produce one full painting without scroll borders, calligraphy or added buildings.

preserve: Number and relative scale of principal landforms
Recognizable mountain silhouettes and watercourse direction
Foreground, middle-distance and distant overlap order
Locations of existing trees, paths and structures where visible
negative: Invented peaks, temples, bridges or boats
Turquoise photographic color grading without painted structure
Equal detail and saturation at every distance
Miniature diorama depth or thick oil-paint relief
Scroll frames, poetry, seals, labels and watermarks
acceptanceZh: 主峰轮廓与水路走向可以对应原照
山面存在清楚的勾线与矿彩覆盖层
远近由重叠、色层厚薄和细节密度共同表达
水域保持开阔，未添加楼阁船只或题字
acceptanceEn: Principal ridges and watercourse remain traceable to the source
Mountain faces show drawn structure beneath mineral color
Overlap, pigment density and detail jointly establish depth
Water remains open with no added architecture, boats or inscriptions
geometryNoteZh: 仅用于含明确山体或岩石地形的风景；平坦街景、肖像和产品不套用山水模板，不凭空增造山峰。
geometryNoteEn: Use only for landscapes with legible mountain or rock structure; do not force portraits, products or flat streets into invented mountain compositions.

summaryZh: 不先勾轮廓，以相接相融的湿润色面直接塑造花瓣与叶片，保留花朵的开合和前后关系，画出柔软但明确的体积。
summaryEn: Build petals and leaves directly from meeting washes, preserving botanical overlaps and soft volume without preliminary ink outlines.
samplePrompt: Create a natural close-up garden photograph, vertical 4:5, exactly 1024x1280 pixels. Three coral-pink camellia blossoms grow on one branching shrub: a large open blossom at upper left, a half-open blossom at center right, and a smaller upward-facing blossom at lower center. Glossy dark green oval leaves cluster around the stems, with small rain droplets. Soft overcast daylight and a blurred olive garden background. Show all three blossoms completely with space around the outer petals; preserve realistic botanical attachments, no extra species or vase. Ordinary unedited camera photography, no painting, lettering, watermark, border or logo.
sampleAnalysis: Planned source: three camellia flowers form a loose triangle, largest upper left, half-open center right, smallest lower center, surrounded by attached oval leaves. Verify actual counts, stem connections and flower opening directions before conversion.
mediumAnchor: Repaint the photograph using boneless botanical color painting: forms arise directly from layered wet pigment masses without enclosing ink contours.

fragments.text: Construct each major petal and leaf with joined pigment washes; let color boundaries define their forms without preliminary black outlines.
Derive muted flower and foliage colors from the source; pool deeper pigment at observed overlaps instead of outlining every edge.
Keep flower opening directions, petal whorls and stem attachments coherent; reserve lighter wash for folded petal tips.
Alternate soft wet junctions with crisp dry edges; retain subtle absorbent-paper texture without uncontrolled blooms across focal flowers.
Preserve the original arrangement and simplify background into sparse tonal washes; add neither botanical specimens nor decorative text.
Deliver a complete color painting with luminous overlapping washes, not a faded photograph, outlined sketch or collection of separate stickers.

preserve: Number, size hierarchy and opening directions of visible flowers or fruit
Leaf attachment, stem continuity and overlap order
Original subject arrangement and frame boundaries
negative: Black enclosing outlines
Detached petals or impossible leaf attachments
Photographic texture beneath a watercolor filter
Uniform blurry edges everywhere
Botanical labels, seals, signatures and sticker sheets
acceptanceZh: 花朵数量、开合与主要枝叶位置对应原图
无黑色封闭外轮廓，色面承担造型
湿边和清晰干边并存，焦点不糊成团
整幅植物绘画，不添加标签或拼贴底板
acceptanceEn: Flower counts, opening directions and major foliage match the source
Color masses define forms without black enclosing contours
Soft wet junctions coexist with crisp focal edges
The result is one botanical painting without labels or collage backing
geometryNoteZh: 优先使用花卉、枝叶与果实原图；对花瓣、果皮和叶片分别设色，不把非植物产品强行改成花。
geometryNoteEn: Prefer flowers, foliage and fruit; handle their distinct surfaces separately and never convert unrelated products into invented plants.

summaryZh: 仅用细而有起伏的墨线交代轮廓、折面和内部结构，画面不铺色、不做明暗排线，让原有物形与疏密关系保持清晰。
summaryEn: Describe silhouette, folds and internal structure using controlled ink lines alone, with no color fills or tonal crosshatching.
samplePrompt: Create a natural still-life photograph, vertical 4:5, exactly 1024x1280 pixels. One small unglazed round teapot sits at lower left on a folded ivory linen cloth, its spout pointing left and handle on the right. One empty shallow porcelain cup is just in front of the teapot at lower center. A single open bamboo basket with a tall arched handle stands behind them on the right. The full basket, teapot and cup remain inside the frame. Soft window light from upper left, pale neutral wall, realistic woven bamboo, ceramic and linen detail, no branding or inscriptions. Ordinary source photograph, no drawing, decorative frame, text, watermark or logo.
sampleAnalysis: Planned source: one round teapot at lower left with left-facing spout, one shallow cup in front, and one open handled bamboo basket behind at right; linen lies under the ceramics. Verify object boundaries, handle holes and overlap order from the generated photo.
mediumAnchor: Translate the photograph into baimiao fine-line drawing, using controlled ink contour and internal structural lines on plain warm paper without tonal shading.

fragments.text: Draw continuous, deliberately weighted contours; taper line starts and turns while keeping handles, rims and folds geometrically readable.
Select internal lines that explain construction or anatomy; retain repeated weaving, seams or veins only where visible in the source.
Use near-black ink on warm off-white paper; leave enclosed areas unfilled rather than converting source shadows into gray washes.
Keep object scale, placement and overlap order; remove incidental background texture without separating objects into diagram panels.
Balance dense descriptive passages with quiet contours; avoid sketchy searching lines, crosshatching, stippling and decorative border systems.

preserve: Object silhouettes, hole shapes and rim ellipses
Visible structural repetitions and attachment points
Original proportions, perspective and front-to-back relationships
negative: Crosshatching, tonal wash or colored fills
Loose repeated searching lines
Closed handle holes or broken spouts
Invented ornament, labels and diagrams
Stickers, comparison layouts, signatures and watermarks
acceptanceZh: 物体比例、开孔和相互遮挡保持正确
线条连续有提按，不是松散速写重线
不出现阴影排线、灰色大块或彩色色面
内部细节解释结构而非凭空加装饰
acceptanceEn: Proportions, openings and occlusions remain correct
Continuous weighted lines replace searching sketch marks
No crosshatching, broad gray shading or colored fills appear
Internal detail explains existing construction without invented ornament
geometryNoteZh: 适合边界清楚、结构可读的器物和人物；产品开孔、把手、衣纹与五官按原图保留，不用统一轮廓替换。
geometryNoteEn: Use clearly bounded objects and readable portraits; preserve actual openings, handles, garment folds and facial geometry rather than generic outlines.

summaryZh: 用顺着山势舒展的长短皴线塑造土石体积，再以淡墨分出远近，让照片中的缓坡、树丛与水岸成为有笔触骨架的墨景。
summaryEn: Shape rounded terrain with long fibrous strokes that follow its slopes, then separate distance through restrained ink washes and grouped foliage.
samplePrompt: Create a natural landscape photograph, vertical 4:5, exactly 1024x1280 pixels. Rounded earth hills descend diagonally from upper right toward a calm reservoir at lower left. A winding pale footpath follows the near slope from lower right toward the center. Two compact groves of deciduous trees sit at the middle bend; distant low ridges recede behind the main hill. A small strip of overcast sky at the top, muted autumn grasses, exposed brown earth and gray-green water. No sharp alpine peaks or dramatic cliffs. Complete coherent terrain inside the frame, realistic outdoor photography, no buildings, people, lettering, logos or watermarks.
sampleAnalysis: Planned source: a dominant rounded hillside descends from upper right to lower-left water, with one winding near-slope path and two compact mid-distance tree groves. Low ridges recede behind. Verify actual slope boundaries and path continuity.
mediumAnchor: Repaint the landscape with hemp-fiber texture strokes: long, pliant ink lines describe rounded earth slopes, supported by sparse layered washes.

fragments.text: Run varied long and short fibrous strokes along the observed slope direction; bend them around convex terrain rather than filling evenly.
Let dry brush strands separate within major strokes; cluster them around exposed earth and soften their density across vegetated planes.
Use warm black ink and pale gray washes on soft ivory paper; reserve darkest accents for nearby roots and slope junctions.
Maintain original ridge profiles, path continuity and water boundaries; express recession through overlapping hills and reduced stroke density.
Group trees according to their source silhouettes; simplify leaves into restrained ink clusters without adding scenic architecture.
Keep the drawing continuous across the frame, with visible structural brushwork rather than silhouette fragments, photorealistic shading or decorative calligraphy.

preserve: Principal slope direction, ridge profiles and terrain curvature
Paths, water boundaries and grove locations
Depth ordering of near and distant hills
negative: Sharp invented alpine peaks
Random parallel hatching unrelated to slopes
Dense black silhouettes replacing interior terrain
Temples, boats and decorative pine trees absent from source
Calligraphy, seals, frames and watermarks
acceptanceZh: 原图缓坡和水岸轮廓保持可辨
皴线顺山体转折，不是均匀排线滤镜
近景笔触较密，远山墨层更轻
保留路径连贯，不增加亭台楼阁
acceptanceEn: Rounded slopes and shoreline remain recognizable
Texture strokes turn with terrain rather than uniform hatching
Nearer strokes are denser and distant washes lighter
Paths remain continuous without invented architecture
geometryNoteZh: 优先低缓山丘、土坡和有植被的山体；尖锐冰川、平原与城市街景不强行套披麻皴。
geometryNoteEn: Prefer rounded hills, earthen slopes and vegetated terrain; do not force this stroke system onto glacier spires, flat plains or city streets.

summaryZh: 以整齐而有轻微笔性的界线重绘建筑，保留梁柱、檐口与窗格的真实关系，用薄淡设色区分材料和远近。
summaryEn: Rebuild architecture with precise brush-like ruled lines, faithful structural connections and thin color washes that distinguish materials and depth.
samplePrompt: Create a natural architectural photograph, vertical 4:5, exactly 1024x1280 pixels. A simple unbranded timber gallery runs diagonally from the near lower right toward the upper left beside a narrow canal. Four visible wooden posts support one gently pitched tiled roof; a low railing connects the posts. Rectangular lattice windows appear on the rear wall. One small stone step meets the water at lower center. Soft cloudy daylight, weathered natural wood, gray roof tiles and subdued green water. Keep the complete roof corners, all four posts, railing and stone step visible, consistent perspective, no people, ornamental dragons, text, signage, watermark or logo.
sampleAnalysis: Planned source: one timber gallery recedes diagonally, with four visible posts, one pitched roof, rear lattice windows and a connecting low railing; a stone step touches the canal at lower center. Verify bay count, post connections and vanishing directions from the actual image.
mediumAnchor: Render the architecture as ruled-line painting, combining precise structural brush lines with restrained ink washes and light earth-colored pigment.

fragments.text: Trace beams, posts, eaves and window divisions with precise ruled lines; retain slight brush variation without wobbling their structural alignment.
Follow the source perspective, building footprint and visible bay count; keep converging edges consistent within each architectural plane.
Preserve load-bearing connections, railing joins and roof intersections; simplify repeated tiles while maintaining their direction and spacing hierarchy.
Apply thin warm wood, gray tile and muted water washes within the drawn structure; avoid opaque graphic color blocks.
Describe recesses with restrained layered ink, preserving open windows and under-eave depth without heavy photorealistic shadows.
Deliver one complete architectural painting, not a technical blueprint, exploded diagram, editorial poster or invented historic monument.

preserve: Observed perspective and complete building silhouette
Number of visible structural bays and support posts
Connections between roofs, columns, rails, doors and windows
Existing setting and waterline or ground contacts
negative: New wings, extra posts or altered roof styles
Contradictory vanishing points
Unconnected beams or closed window openings
Dimension labels, plans, exploded views and diagrams
Decorative titles, seals and watermarks
acceptanceZh: 梁柱、屋顶和窗格数量按原图核对
透视线一致，构件有真实连接
界线准确且有笔性，设色薄而安静
未新增古建装饰、标注或海报文字
acceptanceEn: Structural bay, post and window counts match the source
Perspective is coherent and structural elements connect
Precise brush-like lines carry thin quiet washes
No historic ornament, measurements or poster typography are invented
geometryNoteZh: 用于建筑或真实建筑模型，先核对承重与透视；不将任意城市楼房改造成古代宫殿。
geometryNoteEn: Use architecture or physical architectural models; verify support connections and perspective, and never replace ordinary buildings with invented palaces.

summaryZh: 把照片重绘成铺在墙面上的哑光矿彩，轮廓沉稳、色块层叠，少量风化露出底层，仍保留原场景和人物姿态。
summaryEn: Repaint the photograph as matte mineral pigment on plaster, with steady contours, layered color and selective weathering that preserves the original scene.
samplePrompt: Create a natural environmental portrait photograph, vertical 4:5, exactly 1024x1280 pixels. One fictional adult woman with dark tied-back hair stands slightly left of center, holding a plain rounded terracotta vessel at waist height with both hands. She wears a loose muted ochre linen blouse and dark blue skirt. Her head turns gently to the right while her shoulders remain nearly frontal. A plain warm plaster wall and one low wooden stool at lower right form the setting. Entire head, both hands, vessel and body down to mid-shin visible with space around them. Soft diffuse daylight, ordinary realistic human anatomy, no jewelry, religious symbols, costume embroidery, lettering, logos or watermarks.
sampleAnalysis: Planned source: one adult stands slightly left of center, head turned right, both hands supporting one round vessel at the waist; one low stool sits at lower right. Verify hand contact, facial direction and actual crop before conversion.
mediumAnchor: Repaint the photograph as an original mineral-pigment wall painting with matte earthen colors, deliberate outlines and restrained plaster weathering.

fragments.text: Rebuild every visible subject as layered matte mineral pigment on plaster; retain the source scene rather than imitating a specific historic mural.
Use deliberate dark-earth contours to describe silhouettes, facial landmarks and folds; simplify shading into broad connected planes.
Translate source hues into ochre, clay red, mineral blue and subdued earth colors; retain recognizable clothing and object color relationships.
Add fine plaster grain and a few localized pigment losses; keep faces, hands and important object boundaries sufficiently intact.
Preserve poses, contacts and scene spacing; avoid adding religious figures, halos, ornamental borders or historical costumes.
Keep weathering subordinate to readable painted forms; do not collage cracked-wall photographs over otherwise unchanged source imagery.

preserve: Identity-defining facial proportions and source pose
Hand-to-object contacts and visible anatomy
Subject count, clothing silhouette and object placement
Relative color relationships and original framing
negative: Copied historical compositions or religious iconography
Invented halos, jewelry or costume motifs
Cracks obscuring faces and hands
Photographic skin beneath a wall overlay
Borders, inscriptions, signatures and watermarks
acceptanceZh: 人物姿态、手部接触和物体数量正确
所有主体均转为绘制形体而非照片贴墙
风化只在局部，不遮蔽主要五官和动作
没有凭空添加宗教符号或历史装饰
acceptanceEn: Poses, hand contacts and object counts remain correct
All subjects are painted rather than photographs pasted onto plaster
Weathering is local and leaves important features readable
No religious symbols or historical ornament are invented
geometryNoteZh: 适合人物与生活场景；完整保留身份、动作和衣物结构，只转换画材，不把人物扮成特定古画角色。
geometryNoteEn: Use portraits and everyday scenes; preserve identity, gestures and garment structure while changing medium rather than recasting subjects as historical figures.

summaryZh: 保留花木或动物的姿态，把背景压成细腻金箔地，以少量沉着设色和轻微屏面折线呈现装饰绘画，主体跨折面连续。
summaryEn: Keep botanical or animal poses while flattening the background into fine gold leaf, with restrained painted forms crossing subtle screen folds continuously.
samplePrompt: Create a natural wildlife photograph, vertical 4:5, exactly 1024x1280 pixels. Two white egrets stand on a dark muddy riverbank across the lower third, one at lower left facing right and the other near lower center facing left. A single weathered pine trunk rises on the right and one long branch stretches diagonally across the upper half toward the left, carrying compact needle clusters. Pale still river water and a soft misty bank lie behind. Both birds are complete, all visible legs and the main branch fit inside the frame. Realistic feathers, bark and needles in gentle cloudy daylight. No people, buildings, gold objects, artwork, text, decorative borders, logos or watermarks.
sampleAnalysis: Planned source: two complete white egrets face inward along the lower bank; one pine trunk at right sends a branch across the upper half toward the left. Verify bird count, feet, branch continuity and actual overlaps before repainting.
mediumAnchor: Recompose the photograph as an original gold-ground screen painting, preserving its subjects while using subtle gold-leaf planes and disciplined decorative brushwork.

fragments.text: Retain the observed subjects and their relative positions; simplify background into a continuous gold ground with two or three subtle vertical folds.
Render gold as softly mottled leaf with faint square joins, not glitter, embossed foil, luminous yellow light or a mirror.
Use confident tapered contours for branches, feathers and leaves; simplify internal detail into deliberate decorative rhythms derived from the source.
Keep restrained ink, muted greens and warm whites against the gold; preserve distinctive source subject colors where essential.
Let branches and silhouettes cross fold lines without interruption, duplication or altered scale; folds affect the support, not subject anatomy.
Fill the image with the painted screen surface; add no furniture, room mockup, ornamental outer frame, seals or inscriptions.

preserve: Subject counts, poses and spatial spacing
Continuity of branches, limbs and contours across folds
Major color identities and existing negative-space relationships
negative: Extra birds, invented flowers or decorative emblems
Broken or repeated subjects at folds
Sparkling glitter, embossed metal relief or mirror reflections
Room mockups and freestanding screen furniture
Historical signatures, calligraphy, seals and watermarks
acceptanceZh: 主体数量与主要枝干方向吻合原照
金箔呈柔和片状而非金色灯光或浮雕
跨屏面折线的主体保持连续不重复
没有房间样机、外框、题字或印章
acceptanceEn: Subject counts and major branch directions match the photograph
Gold reads as softly joined leaf rather than lighting or relief
Subjects remain continuous and unduplicated across screen folds
No room mockup, external frame, inscription or seal appears
geometryNoteZh: 适合枝叶、花鸟和轮廓清晰的自然物；屏面折线只改变支撑面的轻微明暗，不能折断动物或枝干。
geometryNoteEn: Prefer foliage, birds and clear natural silhouettes; screen folds alter support shading subtly without breaking animals, stems or branches.

summaryZh: 将照片拆成有刻线骨架的平面色区，以水性颜料的柔和渐晕、木纹和轻微套版痕迹重绘，保留完整景物与前后层次。
summaryEn: Rebuild the photograph as carved contour lines and flat color blocks, softened by water-based gradations, wood grain and restrained registration marks.
samplePrompt: Create a natural coastal landscape photograph, vertical 4:5, exactly 1024x1280 pixels. One small plain white lighthouse with a dark lantern cap stands on a grassy headland at upper right. The rocky coast descends diagonally toward the lower left, where three broad foamy wave bands curve around a dark foreground rock. A muted blue sea fills the left and middle distance; a thin cloud layer sits above a level horizon. Entire lighthouse and headland summit visible, realistic ocean scale and soft afternoon daylight. No boats, people, writing on the lighthouse, illustration, poster layout, decorative border, logos or watermark.
sampleAnalysis: Planned source: one lighthouse stands on the upper-right headland, a diagonal rocky coast leads toward lower left, and three major wave bands curve around one foreground rock. Verify wave grouping, horizon and lighthouse silhouette from the generated photo.
mediumAnchor: Translate the source into a water-based woodblock print with carved contour structure, layered flat colors and controlled watery gradations.

fragments.text: Build silhouettes and key internal boundaries from carved dark keylines; vary their thickness according to the source forms, not uniform tracing.
Reduce the source to five or six coordinated ink colors; use water-based tonal gradations within broad sky, water or background blocks.
Show delicate wood-grain traces and paper absorption inside printed areas; keep registration shifts subtle and subordinate to important contours.
Retain framing, horizon and major spatial planes; simplify continuous shading into layered shapes without rearranging the landscape.
Translate repeated waves, foliage or folds into rhythmic carved marks following their observed directions; do not invent iconic motifs.
Produce a full-image print without halftone dots, photographic comparison strips, title cartouches, seals or decorative typography.

preserve: Major silhouettes, horizon and perspective
Direction and location of repeated natural patterns
Counts and relative scale of recognizable structures
Original foreground-to-background ordering
negative: Copied famous compositions or stock wave motifs
Riso halftone dots and coarse screen-print grain
Large decorative registration errors
Added buildings, boats or people
Title boxes, seals, signatures, borders and watermarks
acceptanceZh: 轮廓和地平线与原照一致
色区由刻线组织，部分大色面有水性渐晕
木纹细微，无半色调点阵冒充木版
没有名作母题、标题框或对照条带
acceptanceEn: Silhouettes and horizon remain faithful to the source
Carved structure organizes color blocks with selective watery gradation
Wood grain is subtle and not replaced by halftone dots
No borrowed iconic motifs, title boxes or comparison strips appear
geometryNoteZh: 以原图的真实轮廓决定刻线，不套用固定海浪或山峰构图；细小结构可简化但不能错位。
geometryNoteEn: Derive carving from actual source contours instead of preset waves or mountains; simplify small structures without shifting their locations.

summaryZh: 用厚实主版线和明快套色重绘日常场景，人物动作与物件保持原样，以紧凑轮廓和手工刷色形成朴实热烈的版画。
summaryEn: Repaint everyday scenes with a strong key block and lively color registration, keeping gestures and objects intact within robust handmade print shapes.
samplePrompt: Create a natural documentary-style photograph, vertical 4:5, exactly 1024x1280 pixels. Three fictional adults gather around one low round wooden table in a plain courtyard. A seated adult on the left wears a muted blue shirt and holds a shallow bowl; a standing adult at center wears a cream shirt and passes one peach toward the right; a seated adult on the right wears a faded red shirt and reaches toward that peach. One wicker basket containing several peaches sits at the middle of the table. Full heads, upper bodies, hands, table and basket visible with clear spacing, plausible anatomy and hand contact. Soft morning daylight, neutral plaster background, no festival decorations, children, signage, text, illustration, logo or watermark.
sampleAnalysis: Planned source: three adults form a left-center-right group around one round table; the center adult passes one peach toward the right, the left adult holds one bowl, and a peach basket occupies the table center. Verify actual hand positions and fruit counts before conversion.
mediumAnchor: Translate the everyday scene into an original folk color woodcut with robust black keylines, compact lively shapes and broad hand-brushed color blocks.

fragments.text: Use strong carved black keylines to organize faces, clothing folds and object silhouettes; preserve recognizable gestures without caricaturing anatomy.
Build a limited warm palette of vermilion, yellow ochre, muted blue and foliage green, maintaining meaningful source color differences.
Apply broad opaque color passes with slight hand-brushed variation; keep keyline registration clear around faces, hands and object contacts.
Preserve the source group arrangement and table geometry; tighten visual rhythms through shape simplification rather than moving or duplicating people.
Simplify background into a few solid supporting shapes; add no auspicious animals, ceremonial props, invented lettering or cultural costumes.
Make the result unmistakably carved and printed, with firm silhouettes and small imperfect ink edges rather than glossy cartoon shading.

preserve: Number of people and recognizable facial structure
Observed gestures, hand-object contacts and body orientation
Table silhouette, container positions and overlap order
Everyday clothing and setting without recostuming
negative: Extra fingers, fused hands or duplicated people
New festival symbols, deity figures or costume ornaments
Glossy animation shading
Floating containers or broken hand contacts
Slogans, seals, signatures and watermarks
acceptanceZh: 人数、动作和递接物件关系与原图一致
粗黑主版和独立套色色区清楚可见
人物仍穿原有日常衣物，无凭空民俗装饰
整体为手工版画质感而非卡通滤镜
acceptanceEn: People, gestures and passing-object contacts match the source
A robust key block and separate color passes remain visible
Everyday clothing is retained without invented folk ornaments
The surface reads as a handmade print rather than a cartoon filter
geometryNoteZh: 优先动作简单、遮挡可读的群像与生活场景；准确保持手部递接，不为热闹而添人、添物。
geometryNoteEn: Prefer simple gestures and readable overlaps in everyday groups; preserve handoffs precisely without adding people or props for visual excitement.

summaryZh: 把器物表面和浅浮雕纹理转换为黑墨中的白色拓痕，以压印的虚实保留细节和轮廓，呈现纸张贴附表面的直接触感。
summaryEn: Translate surface relief into white impressions within dense black ink, retaining readable texture and contours through uneven paper contact.
sampleTitleEn: Fern Relief on a Stone Slab
samplePrompt: Create a natural product-detail photograph, vertical 4:5, exactly 1024x1280 pixels. One rectangular warm-gray limestone slab lies flat on a dark matte work surface, viewed almost directly from above. Its surface has a simple original shallow carving of two fern fronds: a longer frond curves from lower center toward upper left, a shorter frond curves from lower center toward upper right. Fine tool grooves and worn stone grain remain visible, with no lettering or symbols. Show all four slab corners and a small margin of the surrounding surface. Soft raking daylight from the left reveals low relief without harsh shadows. Realistic stone photograph, not an archaeological artifact, printed sheet, drawing, watermark or logo.
sampleAnalysis: Planned source: one rectangular slab with four visible corners contains two carved fern fronds sharing a lower-center base; the left frond is longer and the right shorter. Verify frond count, carving orientation and relief visibility against the actual photo.
mediumAnchor: Render the observed textured object as an ink-rubbing-inspired image: dense matte ink surrounds white relief impressions and irregular paper-contact marks.

fragments.text: Translate visible relief into white impressions within dense black ink; derive every major mark from actual surface contours and texture.
Vary ink contact along raised edges and recessed grooves; create tiny broken paper impressions without scattering unrelated scratches across the image.
Use matte charcoal-black ink and warm paper white; avoid colored antiquing washes, metallic highlights and photographic tonal gradients.
Preserve the object's outline, orientation and principal relief pattern; simplify the surrounding setting to quiet paper without introducing a comparison panel.
Retain the hierarchy between broad relief shapes and fine tool marks; keep narrow gaps readable rather than filling them with solid black.
Present an original artistic interpretation, without invented inscriptions, dates, museum labels or claims that a physical historical rubbing was made.

preserve: Object boundary, orientation and principal relief motifs
Existing relief overlaps and branching directions
Surface-detail hierarchy visible in the photograph
negative: Invented inscriptions, characters or ownership stamps
Uniform threshold filter with no contact texture
Unrelated scratch overlays
Photographic lighting retained inside printed marks
Historical provenance claims, labels, borders and watermarks
acceptanceZh: 物体外形和主要浮雕纹路对应原照
白色拓痕与黑墨之间有自然接触变化
细小纹路仍可辨，不是简单黑白阈值化
没有编造文字、年代或历史拓本身份
acceptanceEn: Object outline and major relief patterns match the source
White impressions show natural variation against dense ink
Fine marks remain readable beyond simple threshold conversion
No inscriptions, dates or claims of historical authenticity are invented
geometryNoteZh: 仅用于表面结构清楚的器物或浅浮雕；平滑人脸与无纹理风景不适合，不凭空添加铭文。
geometryNoteEn: Use objects or shallow relief with readable surface structure; avoid smooth faces or textureless landscapes, and never invent inscriptions.

summaryZh: 把原图形体转换成蓝染布上的白色防染纹，细碎蜡裂穿过蓝色区域，边缘有柔和渗染，保留主体轮廓与方向。
summaryEn: Translate source forms into white resist marks on indigo cloth, with fine wax cracks, soft dye bleed and faithful subject silhouettes.
samplePrompt: Create a natural wildlife photograph, vertical 4:5, exactly 1024x1280 pixels. One small blue-and-orange kingfisher perches sideways on a diagonal dry reed in the center right, facing left, its full body, beak, tail and feet visible. Four taller reed stems rise behind it, with two narrow leaves bending toward the upper left. A soft out-of-focus pond fills the background in muted green and gray. Quiet overcast morning light, realistic feather detail and natural reed connections, complete uncropped bird with breathing room. No other birds, insects, text, illustration, patterned fabric, borders, logos or watermark.
sampleAnalysis: Planned source: one left-facing kingfisher perches at center right on a diagonal reed; four taller stems stand behind it and two leaves bend toward upper left. Verify actual reed intersections, foot contact and leaf count from the generated source.
mediumAnchor: Repaint the photograph as indigo wax-resist cloth, using preserved white fabric for subject structure, blue dye fields and restrained crackle veins.

fragments.text: Translate major forms into connected white resist areas against indigo dye; derive all silhouettes and internal marks from the supplied photograph.
Use deep indigo, diluted blue and warm fabric white; organize original light-dark relationships without retaining unrelated source hues.
Show fine irregular wax-crack veins within broad dyed areas and subtle cotton weave; keep cracks sparse around faces and narrow appendages.
Let dye soften resist edges slightly while keeping critical silhouettes, feet, stems and small openings distinct and connected.
Preserve subject placement and direction; simplify the background into supporting dye fields without adding repeated folk symbols or ornamental borders.
Fill the frame with one continuous dyed-cloth image, not a product mockup, patchwork sheet, red paper cutout or printed photograph.

preserve: Subject count, orientation and defining silhouette
Contacts between feet, branches, supports or ground
Relative positions and continuity of stems and narrow appendages
Original composition and principal light-dark hierarchy
negative: Repeated borrowed folk motifs or invented symbols
Broken feet, disconnected stems or filled-in openings
Crackle covering every small feature
Red papercut appearance or ink halftone dots
Clothing mockups, borders, signatures and watermarks
acceptanceZh: 主体数量与朝向保持，细小肢体和枝干连贯
靛蓝色区与白色防染形体清楚分离
蜡裂和布纹细微，未破坏主轮廓
整幅连续染布效果，无图案拼贴或商品样机
acceptanceEn: Counts and orientation remain correct with continuous limbs and stems
Indigo fields and white resist forms remain clearly separated
Subtle crackle and weave preserve essential contours
The image is continuous dyed cloth without motif collages or product mockups
geometryNoteZh: 适合轮廓清晰的花鸟、器物和简单肖像；防染图形必须保留脚爪、把手等关键连接，不机械变成剪纸镂空。
geometryNoteEn: Prefer clear birds, objects and simple portraits; resist marks must preserve important feet, handles and connections rather than mechanically becoming paper-cut holes.
